activities.name: Cubie Wars
activities.description: Leisure event. With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!

activities.name: Dreams in the Capsule
activities.description: Area exploration event. Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. This is the Simulacrum Nexus.

activities.name: Gifts of Waking Moon
activities.description: 7-Day Login Event. During the event, log in to claim the day's login rewards from the event page.

activities.name: Moonlit Path
activities.description: During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock rewards including Accessories, Sigil, Avatar, Motorbike Accessory, and Collection Item.

activities.name: Back to Solaris
activities.description: Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

activities.name: Artisan's Search
activities.description: Featured Combat Event. Lisha, apprentice Artisan, reporting for duty!

activities.name: Bountiful Crescendo
activities.description: Limited-Time Material Double Drop Event. Complete Simulation Challenge and Forgery Challenges during the event and spend Waveplates for double rewards.

activities.name: Waking Moon Fishing
activities.description: The Waking Moon Festival is underway. Participate in the fishing challenge and unlock entries in the Fishing Index to win Astrites! And complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.

activities.name: Echo Erase
activities.description: Leisure Event. The latest flagship offering from Second Coming of Solaris! Come experience the fun of tapping Echo Pieces away!

activities.name: Gifts of Singing Drizzle
activities.description: Limited-Time Login Event. After the event starts, log in to the game daily to add one day to your cumulative login days. Once your cumulative login days meet the requirement, the corresponding cumulative login reward will be ready to claim.

activities.name: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
activities.description: Featured Exploration Event. During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package.

activities.name: Chord Cleansing
activities.description: Limited-Time Echo Double Drop Event. Complete Tacet Suppression challenges during the event and spend Waveplates for double rewards.
